messages.subject: Shipping
messages.text:
I recently came across a video for you brand and was intrigued. I love monarchs and didn't realize that milkweed could be used for so many things.

 
I am quite interested in trying some of your products, but was understandably confused as to why shipping in Canada for products made in Canada by a Canadian company is free when we spend $99, but shipping to the states only needs to be $59.99 USD which converts
 to $84 CAD. Can you explain why this is?

 

 
Megan
